definitions.explanation: Entering the body through the mouth, as a medicine, a vaccine or an infection does. A medical term used mostly in compounds.

examples.japanese: {経口|けいこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{経口|けいこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}して→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take this medicine by mouth.

examples.japanese: ノロウイルス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主|おも}に→主に：01607_omoni⟧{経口|けいこう}⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Norovirus spreads mainly through oral infection.

notes:
Literally "through the mouth": {経|けい} (pass through) + {口|こう} (mouth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経口薬|けいこうやく}: oral medicine
- {経口|けいこう}⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧: oral administration
- {経口|けいこう}⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧: infection through the mouth
- {経口|けいこう}{避妊薬|ひにんやく}: oral contraceptive, the pill
- {経口|けいこう}{補水液|ほすいえき}: oral rehydration solution

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飲|の}み{薬|ぐすり}→飲み薬：19044_nomigusuri⟧: medicine taken by mouth — the everyday word; {経口薬|けいこうやく} is the medical term
- ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧: injection — the contrasting route
